name: Suspicious Sign-In: Ask the User, Then Their Manager
description: Asks the person whose account signed in whether they recognise it, escalates to their manager from the directory when nobody answers, and branches on the signed answer. 'No, that wasn't me' and 'nobody answered' both reach containment behind an analyst approval; 'yes, that was me' closes the case. Never asked on a confirmed true positive, and auto-sent only for alert classes the tenant opted into.
author: AiSOC

user.description: The account the suspicious sign-in was for

source_ip.description: Where the sign-in came from, quoted back to the person being asked

params.message_template: AiSOC saw a sign-in to your account from {{alert.source_ip}}. Was this you?

params.prompt: {{alert.user}} did not confirm this sign-in. Disable the account and revoke its sessions?

steps.name: Tell the SOC what the answer was

params.message_template: Verification for {{alert.user}} came back '{{verification_outcome}}' (asked: {{verification.stage}}). Containment {{verification_outcome}} != acknowledged.

steps.name: Close the case when the user confirmed it was them
